findings.finding: F01 'exactly once' undefined across crash; no atomic host boundary.
findings.answer: Ledger written after the host takes the frame; a crash in between can show it twice, never lose it. Recorded as a spec departure.

findings.finding: F02 replay route is not per-caller authorized; hub /v1 takes no bearer.
findings.answer: Stated trust boundary: any /v1 caller can already subscribe notifications.> live and register interests; the route adds 72 h look-back only, limited to the session's agent subject and registered interests the deployed stream retains. No new auth added.

findings.finding: F03 replay could execute stale BTW/Aside/Steer/Send.
findings.answer: Replayed frames are cards only: no side turn, no accept call, no Dispatch reply; Dispatch already recorded the attempt as not delivered.

findings.finding: F04 followed issue topics lost when the registry reaps interests (10 min grace).
findings.answer: envoy-replay-state persists followed subjects; recoverRegisteredInterests resubscribes registry ∪ newest state; unfollowed topics are absent from the newest state.

findings.finding: F05 no age bound; cursor older than retention.
findings.answer: 72 h horizon; cursor below first_seq moves on and the session gets one notice that older messages may be missing.

findings.finding: F06 initial cursor for upgrade, first follow, re-follow.
findings.answer: No cursor -> starts at the first watermark; no backfill before a session existed, followed a topic, or ran this plugin; re-follow starts fresh.

findings.finding: F07 old listener answers POST /v1/sessions/... with 405, not 404.
findings.answer: New path POST /v1/replay hits the /v1/ catch-all 404 on old listeners; 404 = not served (notice once, probe each heartbeat); 503 REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE and 401/403 notice once; other errors retried silently.

findings.finding: F08 grant is a production cutover replacing the hub VM.
findings.answer: Rollout section: releases, agent-infra PR pinning envoy-infra and listener images in envoy/ and envoy-cluster/, a Dispatch ask under Approval first before it merges, then plugin pins; production check calls /v1/replay and runs the smoke against production.

findings.finding: F09 live messages carry no stream sequence; ordering undefined.
findings.answer: Cursors advance only from replay results; live deliveries only write the ledger. Order promised only inside one sweep (stream order).

findings.finding: F10 pending live claim vs completed delivery race.
findings.answer: Dedupe exposes none/pending/done; a pending identity leaves a hole (cursor stops before it) so a later live failure is retried by a later sweep.

findings.finding: F11 cursor invariants: holes, watermark, stream recreation.
findings.answer: Exclusive after; watermark = last_seq at request start; next_after per subject; holes cap the cursor; cursors bound to stream created time, reset with a notice when it changes.

findings.finding: F12 replayed subscription.removed could close a re-followed topic.
findings.answer: A replayed removal applies only when its seq is above that topic's since; the live path is unchanged.

findings.finding: F13 session switch, fork and handoff ownership of sweeps and state.
findings.answer: A sweep belongs to its session id and checks the host before each delivery and each state write; replaced-session frames wait in the stream until that id resumes; Claude /clear handoff starts fresh.

findings.finding: F14 deliver() resolving does not mean injected.
findings.answer: Replay delivery is a separate card path reporting shown/suppressed/failed; the live path records the ledger only once the host took the frame or a correlated reply was posted.

findings.finding: F15 'reported where the session sees it' undefined for headless panes.
findings.answer: Third failure -> one sendMessage notice card (model-visible in every mode) naming sender, event id, summary, time, error; if it fails too: logger.warn + ui.notify and retried next sweep; Claude: channel/bridge, else stderr.

findings.finding: F16 stored role forwards on the agent subject.
findings.answer: Passed over by dedupe-key prefix envoy.role.forward. or role envelope topic; a live role frame failing after its receipt gets the notice at once.

findings.finding: F17 which subjects and rendering filters.
findings.answer: All followed subjects the deployed stream retains (checked against STREAM.INFO config, wildcard-aware); renderer skips advance the cursor without a ledger entry so an eligible copy still shows.

findings.finding: F18 persisted dedupe semantics.
findings.answer: Ledger keeps event_id and qualifying dedupe_key with recorded time, expiry 72 h from that time, cap 20,000 (documented limit).

findings.finding: F19 sweeps could stall registration/role work.
findings.answer: Own chain outside passes/roleMoves, single-flight with one rerun, server bounds (32 subjects, 100-500 msgs, 2 MiB, 5 s), client 10 s timeout, 20 pages per sweep, errors contained.

findings.finding: F20 transcript growth and Claude file safety.
findings.answer: State written only when changed; ledger entries per shown frame; Claude file 0600, atomic rename, ledger trimmed at write, never pruned; failed write logged, memory kept.

findings.finding: F21 Claude Code has the same loss.
findings.answer: Said on the issue (comment bd66a966); included in scope with tests for channel and bridge-inbox paths and a 31-day resume; success = admission write.

findings.finding: F22 acceptance needs bounded observable oracles.
findings.answer: Acceptance table names commands, cases, observation windows (2 heartbeats, then 3 more) and the live script's natsd /connz gap check, stream-stored check and released-plugin control.

findings.finding: F23 docs list misses contracts comment and dashboard caveat.
findings.answer: contracts dispatch-api.ts 1213-1229 updated for new plugin versions; dashboard 'unless the session restarted' stays true while older plugins run and is not changed; live-only role/team text kept.

findings.finding: F24 'most likely place' for BET-5 is unsupported.
findings.answer: Plan treats it as a supported mechanism and regression scenario only; the spec's wording is the architect's.

findings.finding: F25 facts overstated members-only credentials and persisted inbound state.
findings.answer: Plan's facts narrowed; replay goes through the listener so it works for keyed and credential-free sessions alike; handled-attempt record described as anti-reacceptance.

findings.finding: F26 outbox destinations described too broadly.
findings.answer: Plan separates retained session destinations from core role routes and uses the deployed stream config for eligibility.

specDepartures.spec: Out of scope: Claude Code sessions, unless the planner finds they lose messages the same way; then say so on this issue.
specDepartures.plan: Claude Code's channel server gets the same recovery through the shared engine, with its own tests.
specDepartures.evidence: packages/claude-envoy/src/channel-forwarder.ts 101-158 and envoy-channel-server.ts 540-549 receive on plain core subscriptions registered selfSubscribed/port 0, which the listener skips (packages/envoy/internal/session/session.go 62-64); said on the issue: dispatch://INFRA-439/comment/bd66a966-a9b1-4419-bd6d-aecee98ee307.

outcome.scope: Adds packages/claude-envoy (channel and Legion bridge inbox paths) to the delivered scope.

specDepartures.spec: Outcome: an event reaches the session once, also when published while down, as long as the session comes back under the same session id.
specDepartures.plan: Holds within the stream's 72 h retention and from the moment the session first runs this plugin or follows the topic; older or pre-existing history is not replayed and the session is told once that messages may be missing; a crash between host admission and the ledger write can show a frame twice, never lose it.
specDepartures.evidence: ENVOY_NOTIFICATIONS MaxAge 72 h (packages/envoy/internal/bus/stream.go 111-122); no prior delivered ledger exists (packages/envoy-client/src/delivery.ts 201-289, memory only); pi.sendMessage returns void with no commit hook (packages/pi-shared/src/pi-types.ts 389-418).

summary: Reaches the session once within the stream's 72 h, from when the session first ran this plugin or followed the topic; a crash in the window between the host taking a frame and its record can repeat it, never lose it.
